svg.title: Lab 07 — OSPF inside, eBGP outside
svg.desc: R1 and R2 learn the enterprise topology with OSPF; R2 and the ISP exchange reachability with eBGP between AS 65001 and AS 65002
svg.text: R1 and R2 learn the enterprise topology with OSPF; R2 and the ISP exchange reachability with eBGP between AS 65001 and AS 65002
R2 ↔ ISP over TCP 179: Idle → Active → Established
R1 default → R2 → ISP → server and back
OSPF = fastest path inside · BGP = policy between organisations
Shut the R1–R2 link: the OSPF neighbour drops and PC0 loses its default route within the dead interval.
Shut the BGP session instead: R1 keeps working internally but R2 can no longer reach 198.51.100.0/24.
